alivecombat.configuration.title: AliveCombat Configuration
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackMode:
CLICK: Tap once to trigger automatic attacks for a short duration.
PRESS: Hold down the attack key to keep attacking automatically.
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackDura:
Specifies how long automatic attacks last in CLICK mode.
Measured in ticks (1 tick = 0.05 seconds).
alivecombat.configuration.fakeSweepEnabl: Displays visual sweep attack particles when attacking.
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackEnab: Automatically attacks the target you are aiming at.
alivecombat.configuration.spamAttackEnab: Prevents missed attacks from resetting your attack cooldown.
alivecombat.configuration.fastIndicatorE: Adds frame interpolation to make the attack indicator appear smoother.
alivecombat.configuration.passCollisionl: Allows attacks to pass through non-solid blocks, such as tall grass.
alivecombat.configuration.passDeadEnable: Allows attacks to hit targets behind mobs that are playing their death animation.
alivecombat.configuration.passAllyEnable:
Allows attacks to pass through allied mobs, such as tamed wolves.
Hold Shift to temporarily disable this.
alivecombat.configuration.holdAttackEnab:
Allows attacking while using items.
For example, attack while drawing a bow.
